name: Aurum Astra
_readme: Canonical, machine-readable design tokens for Aurum Astra — colors (both themes), type scale, spacing, and radius. Source: docs/brand/AURUM_ASTRA_Brand_Guidelines.pdf plus the photography/voice extensions in docs/brand-guidelines.md. The same tokens also live as a browsable page at the 'Aurum Astra Design System' artifact (https://claude.ai/artifact/VGLGfHYLtAS2eetBtz3cDN) — update both together if either changes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark is the brand's true, most-used ground — maroon interiors, hero sections, the primary logo lockup. Light is the deck's own alternate for pale print/UI contexts.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, and any surface sitting above the page background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, and the wordmark's ink color on each surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, supporting copy, the descriptor line under the wordmark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, active states, the brandmark's star accent and circular enclosure line.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and key calls to action — the color that must draw the eye on each surface.

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Raw brand maroon from the source deck (#3f1113), for anywhere a component needs the exact brand maroon regardless of active theme.

tokens.name: gold-bronze
tokens.usage: Raw brand gold from the source deck (#ac7f3f) — the darker stop of the metallic gradient used on logo lockups and gold cards.

tokens.name: gold-mid
tokens.usage: Raw brand gold from the source deck (#ba8c50) — the metallic gradient's midtone.

tokens.name: gold-champagne
tokens.usage: Raw brand gold from the source deck (#f0c382) — the lightest, highlight stop of the metallic gradient.

type._note: Circe Contrast is a licensed typeface — not bundled in this repo. Inter is hosted on Google Fonts and already used by the live site.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps — icon-to-label, inline chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; card inner padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on larger surfaces; gap between a heading and its body.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between distinct sections within a page.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, avatar frames, and the circular enclosure around the brandmark.
